# Fluxco Raises $26 Million for AI Platform to Find the Right Transformer

## With the rise of data centers, Fluxco aims to help buyers sort through the convoluted process of selecting what is a key component of electrical grids, then compare prices

By

[Luis Garcia](https://www.wsj.com/news/author/luis-garcia)

WSJ Pro

July 23, 2026 6:30 am ET

* * *

Listen

(2 min)

![Workers moving radiators for a large power transformer at a Hitachi Energy plant. in Virginia](https://images.wsj.net/im-67057545?width=700&height=560)Workers building industrial transformer components at a Hitachi Energy plant in Virginia.Photo: Jeremy M. Lange for WSJ

Congruent Ventures and 8VC led a roughly $26 million seed investment in Fluxco, a startup that aims to streamline the process of finding and buying an electrical transformer for newly built energy-intensive [data centers](https://www.wsj.com/topics/industry/data-centers) and factories.

The process of identifying the features needed in a particular transformer can be labyrinthine. The transformers—those facilitated by Fluxco can weigh 80,000 pounds—are custom-built for each client, with waits for the vital but workaday equipment at times stretching as long as five years.
